column1: # ReduxOS source-built libretro cores, cross-built for aarch64 (Cortex-A53, H700) by
# tools/build-libretro-cores.sh and injected at image build (CORES_DIR=...). No binary is committed.
# Every core is pinned to a full upstream commit SHA (immutable). None of these upstreams tags the
# pinned commit, so the tag column is "-"; bumping a pin is a PR that also updates PROVENANCE.md.
# Packaged noble cores (nestopia, gambatte, mgba, bsnes-mercury, beetle-*, desmume) are NOT listed here.
# licence: SPDX id, or "nc (...)" for a NON-COMMERCIAL licence. nc cores are SKIPPED unless
#   tools/build-libretro-cores.sh --include-nc is given (private builds only): an image carrying one
#   may not be published as a ReduxOS release, and tools/check-licences.sh fails on it unless ALLOW_NC=1.
# kind: make = make -C <dir> -f <makefile> <args>;  cmake = cmake -S <dir> <args> + build
# so:   the produced file, relative to the source root (or to the cmake build dir for kind=cmake)

column7: platform=unix GLES3=1 FORCE_GLES3=1 WITH_DYNAREC=aarch64 HAVE_PARALLEL_RSP=0 HAVE_THR_AL=1 LLE=0
